description: The logical XOR / EXCLUSIVE-OR operator (ISO 8.8.4.9; precedence NOT > AND > XOR > OR) - a 2023 addition (Annex E.2 item 25 reserves both words; VCR rows 32/41 - the chair-adjudicated regating of the former '2002' mislabel). The operator parses at every edition (superset) and is gated on RECOGNITION of the one xorOperator grammar rule every tier spells it through - condition, EVALUATE partial expression and >>IF constant-conditional-expression alike (LogicalOperatorGate, both lanes; kb/Work PB1390/PB1371); below 2023 both words are user-defined words.
citation: ISO §2023:8.8.4.9; a 2023 addition per Annex E.2 item 25 (VCR rows 32/41)
